summary: Static review found no ordinary reproducible isolation fault requiring correction within TASK-511. Frozen source hash matched. No tests, applications, builds or mutations were performed.

findings.claim: Initialization no longer sweeps exports. Exclusive request workspaces and identity-checked deferred cleanup preserve foreign exports and sibling requests.
findings.recommendation: Retain ownership boundaries; TASK-551 still owns crash-orphan recovery and export resource bounds.

findings.claim: Artifact output rejects existing targets, unsafe parents and traversal before destination writes. Helper overrides reject noncanonical paths, symlinks, nonregular files and executables outside /private/tmp before invocation.
findings.recommendation: Treat helper validation as a temporary-path/type check, not proof of build provenance or executable behavior.

findings.claim: Smoke selects fresh support storage, ephemeral settings/safety state, empty roots, paused sampling, disabled notifications, no FSEvents collector and no integration descriptors. Normal startup retains live dependencies; non-smoke support overrides fail before mutation.
findings.recommendation: Retain explicit dependency selection. TASK-512 duplicate-instance/socket edge scenarios remain separate.

findings.claim: Sentinel assertions and missing/unsafe smoke-field rejection support bounded isolation, without establishing full reliability or release readiness.
findings.recommendation: Reconcile static observations with coordinator test evidence and candidate freshness before final acceptance.
